reason: Verify the integrated MVP preserves evidence, process, provider, security, and no-publishing boundaries.
Check the full stage order, deterministic gates, evidence/brand separation, durable state, and terminal package semantics.
Check selection consumes immutable governed projections without re-fetching or weakening existing contracts.
Review migrations, immutable versions, constraints, locks, idempotency, vectors, and evidence/brand foreign-key separation.
Review retryability, audit rejection, reviewable failure, provider safety, and API envelopes.
Review structured telemetry and absence of secrets, prompts, source/brand bodies, raw model output, and PII.
Drive focused child checks and the one final backend/frontend/Doctor/Compose/security/data gate.
Verify the product remains internal, provenance-visible, accessible, manual, and free of publishing paths.
Review material-package composition, statuses, evidence, audit, copy/download, and accessibility behavior.
Review typed API ownership, polling, cache invalidation, browser effects, and failure handling.
Review generated contracts, strict TypeScript, view-state exhaustiveness, and untrusted-content boundaries.
Review component, accessibility, frontend contract, production build, and critical E2E acceptance.
Check all downstream consumers when stage status, payload, version, or package fields change.
Verify implementation matches the established reuse decisions, gaps, child dependencies, and input gates.
